response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), with_baseline AS (SELECT *, AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_short_interest_baseline FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(mix_short_interest_baseline, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM with_baseline ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
